2.209.10
Map.Left
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.Left element specifies the distance of a map from the left of the height of the map's
container. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If the
Map.Left element is not present, its value is interpreted as 0.
The following is the parent element of the Map.Left element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.Left element.
 <xsd:element name="Left" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
